subject: L1·L2·L3 29 Oct: World Bank says commodity prices may jump as Middle East war disrupts energy and shipping.
lead: World Bank says commodity prices may jump as Middle East war disrupts energy and shipping.

tldr.text: World Bank says commodity prices may jump as Middle East war disrupts energy and shipping.
India cut prices on 543 anti-cancer medicine brands, with new caps starting November 9.
Israel’s election count still leaves no majority, and special ballots could change the seat split.

hero.text: Middle East oil shocks is the pattern today: regional conflict is still moving energy prices and wider commodity markets. The World Bank story pushed it most clearly, by linking war-related disruption to a jump in prices.

6318bf62f2.headline: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, its new frontier AI model
6318bf62f2.explain: Google says Gemini 4 Carbon is its strongest model yet, with top results on cybersecurity and long-horizon tasks. It ranked first on Artificial Analysis’s updated v5.0 index and scored well on benchmarks for finding vulnerabilities, exploiting them, and patching them. Google will first give it to a limited group of cyber defenders before wider release.

why.text: Cybersecurity teams and developers will see the model first, before Google opens access to businesses and consumers.

7a44b0a9a5.headline: Apple launches touchscreen MacBook Pro at $2,899
7a44b0a9a5.explain: Apple’s new MacBook Pro now includes a touchscreen, and the starting price is $2,899. The company did not give more details here beyond the launch and price.

why.text: Buyers now have a higher-priced MacBook Pro option with a touchscreen.

3a45e06e0f.headline: Zorit raises Rs 27 crore for its retailer-focused quick commerce model
3a45e06e0f.explain: Zorit, formerly Bijnis, raised nearly Rs 27 crore in a round led by Sparrow Capital, with Info Edge, WaterBridge, Better Capital, angels and employees also joining. The Bengaluru-based startup helps offline retailers source stock from locally held dark stores, meaning nearby warehouses, with delivery in as little as 60 minutes. It says it now runs 12 dark stores in 12 cities and has annualised sales of Rs 120 crore.

why.text: Fresh capital will help Zorit expand its quick commerce infrastructure and product range for offline retailers.

63c9f69881.headline: QwikBuild raises $2.3 million to build enterprise AI software
63c9f69881.explain: QwikBuild raised $2.3 million in pre-seed funding from Globalway, Blume Ventures, Marsshot and DeVC, plus angel investors including Groww founder Lalit Keshre and Cure.fit founder Ankit Nagori. The Bengaluru startup builds bespoke software and AI agents for business operations, and says it can turn manual work into production-ready applications in days. It also announced a joint venture with Globalway to expand into Japan.

why.text: The startup is using the new funding and Japan tie-up to push its enterprise AI products into more markets.

692a1558f7.headline: Let’s Game Now raises Rs 30 crore to expand Indian Super Gaming League
692a1558f7.explain: Let’s Game Now, an esports and gaming tournament platform, raised Rs 30 crore in a round co-led by Anand Mahindra and Bestvantage Investments, with a UAE family office also participating. The company runs online tournaments, large offline events and live broadcasts across South and Southeast Asia. It says the money will accelerate development of the Indian Super Gaming League.

why.text: The funding backs a larger push to build out the Indian Super Gaming League.
why.highlight: build out the Indian Super Gaming League

6ae4878ff8.headline: Karnataka minister Priyank Kharge urges IT workers to keep learning
6ae4878ff8.explain: Karnataka IT Minister Priyank Kharge said AI is changing jobs fast and urged IT professionals to keep upgrading their skills. He spoke at the opening of RSM US Integrated Services India Private Limited’s new office in Bengaluru and pointed to Karnataka’s talent pool as a draw for global capability centres, which handle specialised operations for multinational firms. He also highlighted the state’s Nipuna Karnataka skilling programme, which links training support to employment outcomes.

why.text: Workers in Karnataka’s tech sector will face more pressure to retrain as AI changes what employers want.
why.highlight: pressure to retrain as AI changes

29099ec00f.headline: Report says Pacific undersea cables face higher sabotage risks
29099ec00f.explain: A new report says subsea cable projects owned by US companies such as Google and Meta face major risk from deep-sea sabotage in the Pacific. It also points to Chinese research ships spending a lot of time surveying undersea cables and to Chinese commercial ships being investigated for cable cuts in Europe and Asia. The report comes from the US-China Economic and Security Review Commission, an independent panel that advises Congress.

why.text: Internet backbone infrastructure owned by Big Tech faces greater scrutiny and security risk.

0ebb7cec19.headline: US DOE gives Constellation Energy $5 billion for nuclear upgrades
0ebb7cec19.explain: Constellation Energy will receive $5 billion in government loans to modernize nuclear reactors. Most of the added power is already spoken for by Google, Amazon and Meta, which need electricity for their data centers.

why.text: Big tech’s data centers already have buyers lined up for much of the new capacity.
why.highlight: buyers lined up for much of the new capacity

cd7b21ad37.headline: Chip stocks rise after SK Hynix posts record profit on AI demand
cd7b21ad37.explain: Asian chip shares rose after SK Hynix reported third-quarter operating profit up 632% year on year, driven by demand for advanced semiconductors used in AI systems. The rally lifted US-listed Micron, AMD, Arm and Marvell, and boosted SK Hynix shares in South Korea. Investors are now watching earnings from Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Apple and Intel for signs on AI spending.

why.text: Investors are still betting on AI hardware demand, while waiting for more earnings to test that view.

37be22d33d.headline: OpenAI will buy Google AI chips, report says
37be22d33d.explain: The headline says OpenAI plans to purchase Google’s AI chips. No further details were provided in the item.

why.text: OpenAI is turning to a rival chip supplier as demand for AI computing resources keeps rising.

8d743f5fea.headline: US DOJ is asking about Nvidia’s planned purchase of Hugging Face, sources say
8d743f5fea.explain: According to the headline, the US Justice Department is inquiring about Nvidia’s purchase of Hugging Face. No further details were included in the item.

why.text: Regulators are looking into a possible Nvidia deal for the AI platform Hugging Face.

da0575cf03.headline: Info Edge reports 87% profit jump and approves Rs 150 crore investment
da0575cf03.explain: Info Edge, which owns Naukri, reported consolidated net profit of Rs 650 crore in Q2 FY27, up 87.1% year on year. Revenue from operations rose 12.2% to Rs 904 crore, helped by Rs 428 crore of other income, while the recruitment business remained the biggest contributor. The board also approved an interim dividend of Rs 3 a share and a fresh Rs 150 crore investment in Redstart Labs.

why.text: Higher investment income and steady recruitment revenue lifted profits and let the company announce a dividend.
why.highlight: lifted profits and let the company announce

5a2809d5ba.headline: Cognizant is in talks to invest in AI unicorn Sarvam, report says
5a2809d5ba.explain: Sarvam AI is reportedly talking to Cognizant about a funding round that could value it at $3.5 billion to $4 billion. The Bengaluru startup makes foundation models, computing infrastructure and enterprise apps, especially for Indian languages and local data-security needs. It already has customers including LIC, SBI Life, IDFC First Bank, Tata Capital and CRED, and recently signed an MoU with the defence ministry’s integrated staff office.

why.text: A Cognizant investment would put another major IT services company on Sarvam’s cap table.

130ad7ecea.headline: India cuts prices on 543 anti-cancer medicine brands
130ad7ecea.explain: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority has revised maximum retail prices for 543 brands of anti-cancer medicines, with new rates from November 9. Some cuts are steep: RPG Life Sciences’ Anarzole drops from ₹695.76 to ₹73 for 10 tablets, and Dr Reddy’s Azacytin falls from ₹6,337 to ₹1,495.04. The list covers different strengths and pack sizes and will be updated as manufacturers file more data.

why.text: Drugmakers must sell these brands within the new price caps from November 9.

bb63faf531.headline: ED attaches Jauhar University land and buildings in Rampur
bb63faf531.explain: The Enforcement Directorate attached Jauhar University land and buildings in Rampur, Uttar Pradesh, worth ₹426.46 crore on paper and about ₹1,170 crore at current market value. It says the money-laundering case involves the Maulana Mohammad Ali Jauhar Trust, founder Mohammad Azam Khan, and others. The agency alleges farmers’ land was taken, public funds were diverted, and government contract money was routed back as donations.

why.text: The attached land and buildings are part of the ED’s money-laundering case.

f9342fdb96.headline: Police say AI searches helped build a spurious liquor racket in Dewas
f9342fdb96.explain: Police in Madhya Pradesh’s Dewas district say 26-year-old Ajay Rathore used AI tools to look up how to make liquor at home, then used the internet to find suppliers and buy chemicals from Indore. Investigators say the liquor was poured into discarded bottles, mixed with genuine stock, and sold in rural areas. They are checking whether it was linked to 13 suspected hooch deaths in Chandana and Binjana villages.

why.text: Forensic tests and the broader probe will show whether the liquor caused the suspected deaths and who else was involved.

b451214da1.headline: BJP wins two Bihar Council seats and leads in one more
b451214da1.explain: In Bihar’s eight-seat Legislative Council election, the BJP won Tirhut Teachers’ and Kosi Graduates’ seats and was leading in Darbhanga Graduates’ as counting continued. JD(U) kept Patna Graduates’ but lost three other seats it contested, while RJD, JSP and Independents won one seat each. Counting in Darbhanga turned tense after a dispute between NDA and RJD agents, and five people were detained.

why.text: The results change who controls the Bihar Legislative Council seats being contested and show gains and losses for the main state parties.

1abf129f2d.headline: Netanyahu bloc leads in Israel election count but no majority yet
1abf129f2d.explain: With 85.6% of ballot boxes counted, the pro-Netanyahu bloc was ahead on 53 seats and Gadi Eisenkot’s bloc had 48 in Israel’s 120-seat Knesset. Arab-led parties were at 19 seats, and official counting was still under way. Netanyahu said the election had been “stolen” by Arab-led parties and called for a police and Shin Bet probe into alleged voter fraud.

why.text: Coalition talks could run for weeks because neither bloc has reached the 61 seats needed to govern.

775bae7b29.headline: Israel’s special ballots could still change the seat count
775bae7b29.explain: Israel’s double-envelope votes are special ballots cast by eligible voters who cannot vote at their regular polling stations, such as soldiers, reservists and hospital patients. Around 600,000 to 650,000 or more of these ballots were still waiting to be counted, according to reports cited in the piece. The Central Elections Committee must verify that each voter did not already vote elsewhere before adding them to the tally.

why.text: Those ballots could shift the final seat split and affect which leader gets the first chance to form a government.

b45fed4ab7.headline: Flávio Bolsonaro reaches Miami after Brazil court order
b45fed4ab7.explain: Brazilian Senator Flávio Bolsonaro arrived in Miami after refusing to concede to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Brazil’s Supreme Court had ordered him to surrender his passports within 24 hours, citing a money-laundering probe and the risk he could flee. A senior US State Department official said the US would grant visas to him and his family.

why.text: Brazil's Supreme Court had ordered him to surrender his passports within 24 hours.

ffb43d61bc.headline: Fed holds rates steady as inflation stays sticky
ffb43d61bc.explain: The Federal Open Market Committee kept US interest rates unchanged, in line with market expectations, though two officials voted for a 25-basis-point increase. Traders had priced in a pause, and investors are now focused on how many more hikes the Fed may deliver. The article says inflation remains well above the central bank’s 2% target, with energy costs, tariffs and AI-related demand adding pressure.

why.text: Markets now look to the next inflation readings for clues on whether the Fed will raise rates again.

77fb78cc35.headline: World Bank sees commodity prices jump on Middle East war
77fb78cc35.explain: The World Bank says global commodity prices could surge 23% in 2026, with energy prices projected to rise 32% and Brent averaging $92 a barrel. It warns that more conflict in the Middle East, plus damage to Russian oil infrastructure, could push prices even higher. The report also sees food prices rising more than 10% this year and metals rising 25% in 2026.

why.text: Higher commodity prices could keep inflation elevated and squeeze growth across importing economies.

09f2489496.headline: Real Madrid apologises after China rejects Mbappé defence
09f2489496.explain: Real Madrid apologised after China’s state broadcaster rejected its initial defence of Kylian Mbappé’s remarks about Mao Zedong. China Media Group said it did not accept Real Madrid’s explanation that the comments were unintentional, and La Liga broadcasts in China have been suspended. Mbappé also apologised, but Chinese sponsors including Dongpeng, Mengniu and Shanghai Milkground Food Tech ended partnerships.

why.text: The dispute has disrupted La Liga’s broadcast and sponsorship ties in a major overseas market.

2a56ab9187.headline: Zoo spots escaped capybara seven months after it got loose
2a56ab9187.explain: Marwell Zoo in Winchester, England, says wildlife cameras have photographed Samba, a capybara that escaped in March. Staff have set up more cameras and a feeding area, and they say recovering her is being handled carefully to avoid stressing her. Samba escaped with another capybara, Tango, who was found quickly nearby.

why.text: The search now focuses on keeping Samba in one area long enough for a safe recovery.

efe3a07dc6.headline: Spreadsheet collector passes 1,000 software items
efe3a07dc6.explain: Ariel Fischman, who holds a Guinness World Record for the largest collection of physical spreadsheet software, says he now has more than 1,000 items. He first set the record in 2018 with 506 copies. Fischman, a financial advisor, says he got into collecting after writing about the history of electronic accounting software like VisiCalc, the 1978 program that helped define the spreadsheet format.

why.text: His collection shows how a niche piece of software history can become a serious archive.

quiz.question: Which of today's stories is evidence for Middle East oil shocks?
options: World Bank sees commodity prices jump on Middle East war
BJP wins two Bihar Council seats and leads in one more
India cuts prices on 543 anti-cancer medicine brands
quiz.why: It ties the Middle East war to higher commodity prices.

quiz.question: Which headline would weaken Middle East oil shocks?
options: Global refiners warn of tighter supply after refinery damage
Oil prices fall after a ceasefire restores shipping routes
World Bank sees commodity prices jump on Middle East war
quiz.why: A ceasefire and restored shipping would cut against the shock pattern.

options: It shows inflation has already peaked and can now fall quickly.
It shows oil companies are expanding drilling in the Middle East.
It shows regional conflict can push up commodity prices and stress importers.
quiz.why: The report links war-related disruption to higher commodity prices and inflation risk.
